answers.q1: Yarn 1 (classic) workspaces monorepo, pinned to yarn@1.22.22 with Node >= 18. CI uses Node 20.x. Install dependencies with: yarn install (or just: yarn)
answers.q2: yarn test:app --watch=false   (plain `yarn test` runs vitest in watch mode. To run everything CI-style, including typecheck and lint, use `yarn test:all`.)
answers.q4: yarn install && yarn test:other && yarn test:code && yarn test:typecheck   (this is the sequence in .github/workflows/lint.yml. test:other is `prettier --list-different` on css/scss/json/md/html/yml. test:code is `eslint --max-warnings=0 --ext .js,.ts,.tsx .`. test:typecheck is `tsc`. Autofix with `yarn fix`.)
answers.q5: The repo has no vendored directories. The generated or ignored paths are the ones in .eslintignore: node_modules/, build/, dist/, dev-dist/, coverage/, public/workbox, packages/excalidraw/types, and examples/**/public. Per-package output such as packages/*/dist and excalidraw-app/build is also generated by the build, and `yarn rm:build` deletes it. yarn.lock is generated by yarn, so don't edit it by hand. I didn't open the locale files, so I can't say whether any of them are generated.

q1.reason: Yarn classic with `yarn install`/`yarn` matches the accept criterion; extra Node details are harmless.

q2.reason: `yarn test:app --watch=false` is an accepted one-shot form, and `yarn test:all` is correctly described as the superset.

q3.reason: `yarn test:app --watch=false packages/element/tests/bounds.test.ts` is the accepted form with the flag placed before the path, which is equivalent and runs only that file.

q4.reason: Gives yarn test:other, test:code and test:typecheck matching CI; `yarn fix` is only mentioned as an optional autofix, not as the answer.

q5.reason: Correctly names yarn.lock and build output dirs (build/, dist/, dev-dist), but wrongly says there are no vendored/generated items beyond that and explicitly misses the Crowdin-synced non-en locale files and percentages.json.
